source_behavior.summary: The System Health Run checks control suppresses overlapping checks and re-reads the real health service. Failed refreshes clear the successful snapshot instead of presenting stale or synthetic success.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The visible control refetches the existing tenant-authorized React Query snapshot, stays available after read failure for retry, reports busy state, and suppresses duplicate activation. The workspace renders error state instead of stale success after a failed refetch.

runtime_semantics.queue_cache_scheduler: status probes only; no dispatch or mutation

proof: exact canonical operation marker is bound to the production refresh control
duplicate activation is suppressed before parent busy state can update
busy state disables refresh and exposes truthful checking feedback
refresh uses the existing authoritative React Query endpoint
read failure renders an error state rather than the previous successful snapshot
GET-only snapshot route enforces authentication, tenant context, tenant.view and diagnostics.view
refresh does not mutate tenant membership or role persistence
